purpose: Read-only, vehicle-scoped probabilistic component maintenance guidance based on recorded exposure and component outcomes; not a diagnosis, failure guarantee, repair authorization or vehicle-control surface.
primaryGoal: Review each component's event-free survival probability, P10/P50/P90 horizons, competing risks, modeled intervention sensitivity and the evidence limitations supporting those estimates.

components.usage: PageLayout retains PageContainer composition, full width, min-w-0 and a container context. InsightPanel owns the persistent LayoutCard/SourceContent shell. Grid is imported from the category barrel; its internal implementation was not separately inspected.

Four StatCard metrics per item, named competing-risk progressbars and EvidencePanel quality metadata. StatCard explicitly preserves zero versus missing. KVList usage was read in EvidencePanel, not its implementation.

Reuse embedded StatStrip rather than another KPI grid when modernizing. Generic percent accepts existing 0-100 raw input; duration accepts seconds. Preserve the four domain labels and distinct P10/P50/P90 occurrence identities, nulls, precision and modeled provenance. Snapshot period may use generated_at; do not invent an analysis start or observation time. Existing display.formatter supports retaining specialist duration display when equivalence is not yet proved.
Reuse domain evidence/quality/limitations and source-state adapters. Do not build a second evidence renderer or replacement trust vocabulary.

Existing semantic badge variants, source-preserving pagination, typography roles and maintenance notice. Card supplies theme/forced-color/print surfaces. Text and EmptyState implementations were not separately inspected.

Two finite entrance wrappers; FadeIn respects existing motion preference. CHART_COLORS is the static CVD-safe palette, not the neon palette. Keep every risk at its existing source probability and retain accessible labels; there is no plotted time series, map or chart-toolbar capability on this page.

issues.detail: Component heading and badge remain in a nonwrapping justify-between flex row; its inner heading group lacks min-w-0 or an explicit long-identifier wrapping policy. The unsupported-risk row at line 106 has the same constrained label/value pattern. Long source identifiers or translations can compete for width; no actual overflow was observed.

issues.detail: Article and evidence layout use viewport breakpoints although the canonical shell exposes allocated-container scope. A narrow content allocation on a wide viewport can still request two component or three evidence columns. This is a source risk, not rendered clipping evidence.
issues.fix: Exercise allocated widths before changing reflow; use existing container-query layout contracts if needed, without removing metrics, risks, quality metadata or limitations.

states.retainedRefreshFailure: InsightPanel derives retained state and keeps existing component cards with a nonblocking warning/retry. Evidence reads the same retained first item but does not display its trust state.
states.initialPaused: InsightPanel.tsx:44-48 supplies explicit initial-paused copy instead of claiming an empty server result.
states.retainedPaused: deriveDataState marks retained paused results stale; InsightPanel displays the generic retained warning rather than a source-specific offline explanation.
states.partialUnsupported: Nullable horizons/probability remain missing; null risk probability renders Unsupported while zero is a real MetricBar reading. The domain quality and limitations govern empirical support; no automatic repair action exists.

issues.detail: EvidencePanel receives only representative metadata, never the query/state. Its inner InsightPanel therefore defaults to ready even during initial load, fatal error or paused refresh. Before resolution it states No supporting evidence was returned and No additional limitations were returned, although the source has not answered. After a failed refresh it presents retained evidence without its own source/trust context.
issues.fix: Extend the existing EvidencePanel domain contract with optional query/source state and scope-specific prerequisite message, and pass the same raw query from this page. Preserve persistent quality/evidence/limitations/unsupported sections; replace only unresolved dynamic content with truthful pending/fatal/retained states and the existing retry mechanism. Keep legacy source-less informational usages working.

issues.detail: Caller-owned page state is not scoped/reset to vehicle selection, and Pagination is inside the source body that is replaced on empty. With a multi-page response, changing to a smaller vehicle result can retain an out-of-range offset and hide recovery navigation. The inspected current service emits at most four components, below PAGE_SIZE=12, so this scenario is not reachable with that implementation today; it is a latent contract risk, not a reproduced production defect.
issues.fix: When preserving pagination, associate page state with the selected vehicle and maintain a first-page recovery for out-of-range empty responses. Keep server offsets, query keys and AbortSignal; do not filter only loaded results or fabricate total counts.

visualIssues.detail: Component articles use fixed white-alpha border/background instead of the shared theme surface. Every component also gets a fixed cyan decorative icon at line 65 and a cyan-tinted intervention subpanel at line 121. EvidencePanel.tsx:81 repeats fixed white-alpha evidence cards. These choices bypass shared surface/theme/forced-color hierarchy; effective contrast was not measured.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing panel/surface/border tokens and Card where semantically appropriate. Neutralize decorative Activity/evidence icons; keep restrained semantic quality/unsupported cues. Make intervention context a neutral inset, not an always-cyan highlight. No new palette, glows or theme preference reset.

visualIssues.detail: The required static probabilistic-maintenance notice inherits neon-cyan/25 border and neon-cyan/10 fill from AlertBanner.info; line 54 adds shadow and backdrop blur. This is shared presentation, not a neon chart-color finding. The page's CHART_COLORS[0] is CVD-safe blue, not the neon palette.
visualIssues.fix: Have the feedback owner make the existing info presentation restrained and token-backed, retaining semantic info meaning, title/body/icon, native attributes and onClose behavior. Do not add a page-local banner or suppress the maintenance warning to reduce visual noise.

visualIssues.detail: Every competing risk uses the same valid static CVD-safe blue, but MetricBar defaults to gradient fill. A solid fill is already supported at MetricBar.tsx:27,44,89; the extra gradient is optional decoration rather than new data meaning.
visualIssues.fix: Use the existing fill=solid option with the restrained current palette. Preserve each named risk, real zero, percentage, evidence count, progress semantics, unknown row and motion preference; do not recolor into a rainbow.

architectureIssues.detail: All bottom-panel metadata comes from items[0]. Non-first components show only their quality status, with no access to their reasons, sample/coverage/window metadata, evidence counts, limitations or generated_at. This is not equivalent metadata: the builder at survival_security_charging.go:74-86,99-115,136-143 creates component-specific outcome evidence counts and distinct quality reasons. generated_at is returned for every component but never displayed.
architectureIssues.fix: Expose each component's existing evidence/quality/limitations and generation context through the existing domain owner, either inline or an explicitly labeled per-component detail disclosure. Retain the representative summary if useful, clearly identify its component, preserve source order and avoid unioning distinct component support into invented aggregate quality.

architectureIssues.detail: Survival probability omits the model horizon in its visible label/context. The inspected backend explicitly computes that probability over 365 days at survival_security_charging.go:122-123; P10/P50/P90 are different event-free percentile horizons, not probabilities over those durations. The current generic notice does not establish the probability period.
architectureIssues.fix: Add source-backed localized 365-day survival-probability context without changing the calculation. Keep the 2*365-day evidence window distinct from the 365-day forecast horizon and P10/P50/P90 estimates. If the backend model later changes, require an explicit verified contract rather than inferring a horizon from displayed percentile values.

architectureIssues.detail: Page maps both limited and insufficient to warning while EvidencePanel.qualityVariant maps insufficient to danger. The same selected component can have different semantic quality presentation in the card and evidence panel. This is presentation inconsistency, not evidence of an incorrect backend quality computation.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse one domain quality mapping with localized finite labels and preserve a neutral unknown fallback; do not equate insufficient evidence with confirmed physical failure.

architectureIssues.detail: Per-component KPIs are preformatted strings in four independent StatCards. This is currently null-safe and SI-correct, but bypasses the agreed raw-metric StatStrip pipeline and creates an extra surface per metric.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse existing embedded StatStrip with numeric percent and duration rawValue, distinct occurrenceId and the existing labels/precision/formatting. Keep specialist formatting until its equivalence is verified; no new formatter, glossary inventory or calculation is required.
